transformMethods.name: align
doc: Translate so the bounding box meets a point, per axis: its min, max or center lands on relativeTo.
On an array, each item moves on its own unless grouped is true.
@param {Array} [options.modes=['center','center','min']] - per axis 'min', 'max', 'center' or 'none' (leave that axis alone)
@param {Array} [options.relativeTo=[0,0,0]] - per axis target coordinate; null uses the group's own bounds
@param {Boolean} [options.grouped=false] - move an array's items together, keeping their spacing

measurementMethods.name: measureEpsilon
doc: The geometry's precision: the tolerance modeling uses when comparing its points, scaled from its size.

arrayMeasurementMethods.name: measureBoundingBox
doc: One bounding box per item, in order. For one box around them all, jf.measureAggregateBoundingBox(array).
@returns {Array} [[minX, minY, minZ], [maxX, maxY, maxZ]] for each item

arrayMeasurementMethods.name: measureBoundingSphere
doc: One bounding sphere per item, in order.

arrayMeasurementMethods.name: measureCenter
doc: The center of each item's bounding box, in order.

arrayMeasurementMethods.name: measureDimensions
doc: The size of each item's bounding box, in order.

arrayMeasurementMethods.name: measureEpsilon
doc: Each item's precision, in order. For one value for the group, jf.measureAggregateEpsilon(array).

arrayMeasurementMethods.name: measureArea
doc: Each item's area, in order: geom2 area, geom3 surface area, 0 for a path. For the total, jf.measureAggregateArea(array).

solidArrayMeasurementMethods.name: measureCenterOfMass
doc: Each item's center of mass, in order; Z is 0 for 2D shapes.

geom3ArrayMeasurementMethods.name: measureVolume
doc: Each solid's volume, in order. For the total, jf.measureAggregateVolume(array).

extrudeMethods.name: extrudeHelical
doc: Extrude the shape along a helix about the Z axis, for threads, springs and coils.
The shape's X is its distance from the axis and its Y becomes Z, so place it at positive X.
@param {Number} [options.angle=TAU] - total rotation in radians; positive turns right-handed, negative left-handed
@param {Number} [options.startAngle=0] - rotation of the first slice in radians
@param {Number} [options.height=0] - total rise; when nonzero it sets the pitch from angle
@param {Number} [options.endOffset=0] - change in distance from the axis by the last slice, for a taper or spiral
@param {Number} [options.segmentsPerRotation=32] - slices per full turn; at least 3
jf.circle({ radius: 1, center: [5, 0] }).extrudeHelical({ angle: Math.PI * 4, pitch: 3 })

extrudeMethods.name: extrudeRectangular
doc: Extrude a wall that follows the shape's outlines: expand them by `size`, then extrude `height`.
@param {Object} options - wall options; also takes expand's corners and segments and extrudeLinear's twistAngle and twistSteps
@param {Number} [options.size=1] - wall thickness on each side of the outline
@param {Number} [options.segments=16] - segments per full circle for round corners

geom2Methods.name: measureCenterOfMass
doc: The center of mass, treating the geometry as uniformly dense; Z is 0 for a 2D shape.

geom2Methods.name: toSides
doc: The shape's edges as [start, end] point pairs with transforms applied, for jf.slice.fromSides().

modifierMethods.name: generalize
doc: Clean up the geometry: snap, simplify and triangulate, in that order. On geom2 and path2 it returns an unchanged copy.
@param {Boolean} [options.snap=false] - snap vertices to the geometry's precision (measureEpsilon)

modifierMethods.name: snap
doc: Snap every vertex to the geometry's precision (measureEpsilon), dropping edges that collapse.

retessellateMethods.name: retessellate
doc: Merge coplanar polygons into larger convex ones, as booleans do.

path2BuildMethods.name: appendPoints
doc: Add points to the end of the path.

path2BuildMethods.name: appendArc
doc: Add an elliptical arc from the path's last point to an endpoint, as in SVG's arc command.
@param {Array} options.endpoint - 2D end point of the arc (required)
@param {Array} [options.radius=[0,0]] - X and Y radius; [0,0] draws a straight line
@param {Number} [options.xaxisrotation=0] - rotation of the ellipse's X axis in radians
@param {Boolean} [options.large=false] - take the arc longer than half a turn

path2BuildMethods.name: appendBezier
doc: Add a Bezier curve from the path's last point through the control points; the last control point is the end.
@param {Array} options.controlPoints - 2D control points (required); a null first entry mirrors the previous curve's last control point, for a smooth join
@param {Number} [options.segments=16] - segments per full rotation of the curve's direction

path2BuildMethods.name: close
doc: Close the path, joining its last point to its first.

path2BuildMethods.name: reverse
doc: Reverse the order of the path's points.

geom3Methods.name: measureCenterOfMass
doc: The center of mass, treating the geometry as uniformly dense; Z is 0 for a 2D shape.

geom3Methods.name: measureArea
doc: The total surface area of the solid.
